Stage 1 · The Atrium Job

HIGH-RISEHEAT

23:41, Meridian Tower. A demolition crew is emptying the vault and calling it a renovation. The only official left in the building is a fire-safety inspector. Clear three floors with fists, mops and whatever isn't bolted down.

Renderer … · three r181 · Rapier 0.19 SIMD

How to play

WASD
Move (arrows work too)
J
Punch · swing or fire a held weapon
K
Kick
SPACE
Jump · press J or K in the air for a flying kick
L
Pick up · throw held weapon · grab an enemy in front of you
SHIFT
Dodge roll. Roll through an attack for a Perfect Dodge
I
Backdraft spin when the HEAT bar is full
ESC
Pause
F
Full screen

Strings

JJJ
Jab, cross, hook: knocks down
JJK
Uppercut launcher, then keep hitting to juggle
KK
Front kick into roundhouse
L then J/K
Grab: knee strikes, or throw them into their friends

Gamepad: stick to move, X punch, B kick, A jump, Y grab, RB roll, LB Backdraft. Touch: drag your left thumb anywhere on the left half of the screen to move; the buttons are on the right. When a button prompt flashes during a cutscene, hit it before the ring closes.
